blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Visayas grid will be placed on yellow alert on Saturday late afternoon, Sept. 26, said the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP). READ: NGCP: Mindanao reserves may run out by 2028 In an advisory, the NGCP said the Visayas grid will be placed under yellow alert from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. This is because Visayas grid currently has a capacity of only 2,540 megawatts (MW) despite having a peak demand at 2,312 MW. “A yellow alert is issued when the operating margin is insufficient to meet the transmission grid’s contingency requirement,” the NGCP said.
